question: Who was the founder of the Maitraka dynasty of Vallabhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhatark**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Maitraka dynasty** of Vallabhi was founded by **Bhatark**, a general in the Gupta Empire, around the late 5th century CE.
 
• After the decline of the Gupta Empire, Bhatark established his own rule in **Vallabhi** (modern-day Gujarat) and laid the foundation of the Maitraka dynasty.
 
• **Vallabhi became an important cultural and educational center during the Maitraka rule.**
 
• **The dynasty lasted until the mid-8th century CE** when it was overrun by Arab invaders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yashodharma**n

 
 
• **Yashodharman was a powerful ruler of Malwa** in central India during the 6th century CE.
 
• **Significant achievements:**
 
 
• He is **best known for his defeat of the Hunas (Huns) under their leader Mihirakula,** marking the decline of the Huns' influence in India.
 
• Yashodharman is commemorated in inscriptions, such as the Mandasor Inscription, which celebrates his victory and independence from Gupta overlordship.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Baladitya**
 
 
• **Baladitya was a prominent ruler of the Gupta Empire. **
 
• He **ruled during the late 5th to early 6th century CE **and was likely the son or successor of Skandagupta.
 
• Significant achievements:
 
• **Known for his struggle against the Hunas and his attempts to repel their invasions.**
 
• According to some accounts, Baladitya managed to capture and humiliate Mihirakula, the Huna ruler.
